current_consumers.observed_current_source: OnReturnConfirmedAsync loops RmaDetails, updates ReturnedQty, creates legacy CreditNote with Qty and no Amount assignment, then SaveChangesAsync. This is an actual writer distinct from CreditNoteService query.
current_consumers.missing_adoption: Reviewed Owner migration of the bridge; independent physical return, commercial credit decision and accounting effects; unknown commit/original intent recovery.

current_consumers.observed_current_source: StockFinBridge rounds abs(Qty*UnitPrice) to 2 places and sends FinBizEvent to IAutoVoucherEngine; Program registers enabled/no-op bridge and StockMovementService uses it.
current_consumers.missing_adoption: Each value writer, exact source ownership and valuation policy; no lost-digit reconstruction; storage, concurrency and legacy bridge recovery proven in separate task.

current_consumers.observed_current_source: SupplyBreakdown has four decimal quantities and decimal Total; GetSupplyAsync returns Task<decimal>.
current_consumers.missing_adoption: Exact source ledger/cut, representative dedup, full ATP wire/locks/authorization and real conversion recovery.

current_consumers.observed_current_source: Existing inspection/defect services use legacy DTO/CP6Context/sequence and existing controller permissions; web keeps old HTTP routes. S01-07 owner inventory pinned again at current Main.
current_consumers.missing_adoption: Strict raw native ingress; real QA-POL/MES-EXEC/MES-OUTPUT/current heads; current authorization, independent inspector/reviewer and domain+Command+Audit writes; inventory effects separate.

current_consumers.observed_current_source: Current intake and retention are existing CRM owner/storage flows. Existing LeadCodec is CrmLeadStorageCodec, not S01-08 LeadContractDecoder; do not equate names.
current_consumers.missing_adoption: Native raw decode, IssuedAttempt/H01 atomic graph and public five-field receipt; internal expiry history, proof/session/ETag/download and trusted same-UoW.

current_consumers.observed_current_source: readPublic uses response.json() with TypeScript cast; current form submits legacy PublicFormView/PublicReceipt and redirects by receiptId.
current_consumers.missing_adoption: Use exact terminal revision at real HTTP boundary and render native terminal states; contract example roundtrips do not prove real page behavior.

current_consumers.observed_current_source: Catalog resolver and original-byte holder are standalone library entry points. Fixed src query finds their declarations, no separate production caller at the pinned Platform source.
current_consumers.missing_adoption: Published immutable trusted package identity and actual Main/CRM host adoption; caller-owned Inbox/Outbox/Command/Audit transaction and unknown commit recovery.
